description.value: Piggy & Paisley is a boutique cafe nestled in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, steps from the oceanside bluffs and cycling paths along Dallas Road. It specialises in premium globally-sourced teas, handcrafted in-house pastries, and locally-roasted coffee from suppliers including Bows and Fantastico. The cafe is also known for its reservation-only Afternoon Tea service, offering tiered trays of scones, sandwiches, and desserts in a deliberately serene setting.
